description.zh: 需要续费的计费实例 ID 列表，多个计费实例 ID 用逗号隔开。计费实例包括集群和计算组。
description.en: A comma-separated list of billing instance IDs to renew. Billing instances include clusters and compute groups.

description.zh:
购买时长单位：
  • 月（Month）
  • 年（Year）
仅在 payType 为 PrePaid 时有意义。
description.en:
Duration unit:

- Month

- Year

Valid only when payType is PrePaid.

descriptions.zh:
请确保在使用该接口前，已充分了解 Serverless StarRocks 产品的收费方式和<props="china">[计费项](https://help.aliyun.com/zh/emr/emr-serverless-starrocks/product-overview/billable-items?spm=a2c4g.11186623.help-menu-28066.d_0_1_1.4db82b05p3Gg0G)</props><props="intl">[计费项](https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/en/emr/emr-serverless-starrocks/product-overview/billable-items?spm=a2c63.p38356.help-menu-28066.d_0_1_0.3aaf4b0b69jN1P)</props>。

调用该接口时，您需要注意：只有包年包月实例支持续费。
descriptions.en:
Before you call this API, make sure that you fully understand the billing model and <props="china">[billable items](https://help.aliyun.com/zh/emr/emr-serverless-starrocks/product-overview/billable-items?spm=a2c4g.11186623.help-menu-28066.d_0_1_1.4db82b05p3Gg0G)</props> <props="intl">[billable items](https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/en/emr/emr-serverless-starrocks/product-overview/billable-items?spm=a2c63.p38356.help-menu-28066.d_0_1_0.3aaf4b0b69jN1P)</props> of Serverless StarRocks.

When you call this API, note that only subscription instances can be renewed.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun starrocks renew-instance --instance-id c-b25e21e243880000 --duration 1 --pricing-cycle Year --billing-instance-ids ng-dd8933281e460000 --promotion-option-no youhuiquan_12378dfj6 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun starrocks POST /webapi/order/renew_instance --region cn-hangzhou --InstanceId 'c-b25e21e243880000' --PromotionOptionNo youhuiquan_12378dfj6 --PricingCycle Year --BillingInstanceIds 'ng-dd8933281e460000' --Duration 1 --header "Content-Type=application/json"
